changes.title: Komodo
items: A new animal for the rocky island to the east: the Komodo dragon, a huge lizard with a flicking forked tongue, in its own dry, rocky savannah of acacias and fan palms

changes.title: Trees open areas
items: Trees in the open places: lone hawthorns and rowans on the moor, a ring of old yews round the stone shrine, young elders and aspens among the log piles, rowans and pines clinging to the ravine's rims

More trees where there were few: a great oak in the meadow, hawthorn and crab apple islands on the grassland, pines on the heath, willow clumps in the wetland, denser alders along the streams and in the fen, a giant heron elm, and leaning, gnawed aspens round the beaver pond

changes.title: Debug knobs paused
items: The fight and world test knobs (fight scale, speed and momentum, treetop speed, area size) moved from the debug overlay's bottom-left panel onto the pause page's sliders (Esc)
